checklist_with_code.title: Can gossip validation produce non-deterministic outcomes for the same sidecar input?
checklist_with_code.test_procedure: 1. Trace all execution paths through the gossip validation pipeline. 2. Verify deterministic path selection from q_init to q_final. 3. Check for sources of non-determinism (race conditions, mutable state, time-dependent checks, RNG usage, floating-point precision). 4. Construct adversarial sidecars to trigger divergent outcomes. 5. Review validation caching for consistency.
